plugins.name: claude-code-studios
plugins.description: Full software studio for Claude Code: 45 specialist agents across game AND app/web/service development, 90 workflow skills, and production hooks covering pre-production through live-ops. v0.6.8 makes Codex a subagent of this studio: Claude Code orchestrates and calls Codex through the Codex CLI (codex exec with stdin closed, not the codex-rescue subagent), runtime.txt split now means 'Codex owns these paths', and the codex mode is deprecated. A usage audit across two machines deprecated 8 rarely-reachable skills (removal in v0.7.0) and trimmed session-start noise. (v0.6.7 delivered hook advisories to the model and added opt-in decision authority; v0.6.6 added the install-registry gate.)
